title: The Correspondence of Hugo Grotius (Huygens Institute, eLaborate)
institution: Huygens Instituut (KNAW); edition of P.C. Molhuysen, B.L. Meulenbroek, P.P. Witkam, H.J.M. Nellen and C.M. Ridderikhoff
author: Hugo Grotius
region: Low Countries, France and elsewhere in Europe
notes: Digital version of the printed Briefwisseling van Hugo de Groot (letters written and received by Grotius from 1597 to 1645), with an introduction, name and quotation indices and the editors' Dutch notes. Every letter is readable online without login and can be browsed by year, sender or recipient. Counts are our own: 7,763 letter pages listed in the 49 year lists (1597-1645, including 'A' supplementary letters), and about 3.58 million visible words of the letter pages, fetched on 2026-10-12 and excluding the footnotes; the figure includes headings and page markers, so it is approximate. The site states 'basic digital version, October 2009'; its newest style file is dated 2023-07-04 and nothing newer was found, so it is marked archived.
